description: The file contains unit tests for functions related to filtering and handling of search tool parameters within the LiteLLM project. It verifies proper inclusion and exclusion of specific parameters to prevent errors when interfacing with external search APIs.

methods.name: test_search_tool_name_in_all_litellm_params()
methods.description: Confirms that 'search_tool_name' is included in the all_litellm_params list to prevent errors when sending parameters to providers.

methods.name: test_filter_out_search_tool_name()
methods.description: Ensures that the filter_out_litellm_params function correctly removes 'search_tool_name' and other internal parameters from the user-supplied kwargs.
